articles.title: India plans private entry into missile manufacturing as demand for DRDO's Astra missile rises: Report
articles.summary: India is set to open its missile manufacturing sector to private companies, a significant shift in its defence production policy. articles.title: Daiki Axis setting up 3rd plant in India, bets big on sustainable water treatment sector
articles.summary: Japan's Daiki Axis is investing approximately Rs 200 crore to establish its third water treatment manufacturing facility in India, located in Tumakuru, Karnataka. This strategic move aims to capitalize on India's burgeoning demand for advanced water treatment solutions, bolstering domestic manufacturing capabilities and contributing to infrastructure development, a key aspect for national progress.

articles.title: UAE air defences intercept missiles, drones as regional tensions escalate
